Exterior18|19
Awake to the pleasures of the senses.
In the 6 Series Convertible, driving under the sun and stars is just one of many delightful
sensations. Relax in orthopedically supportive seats upholstered in beautiful, supple leather
that’s specially treated to stay cooler to the touch, even when the top is left down. Feast your
eyes on the artfully designed cabin, filled with the highest quality materials. Rediscover your
favorite songs, clarified through the Logic7 sound system. From top to bottom, inside and out,
the 6 Series Convertible is a never-ending treat.
For details on the availability of standard and optional features, please refer to the Standard equipment | Optional equipment charts
at the back of this brochure.

--- page 11 ---
Exterior20|21
Sometimes high performance is measured by a different yardstick.
Few things are as exhilarating as rocketing from 0 to 60 in 5.3 seconds on an empty highway.1 But when the freeway
is clogged, you’ll appreciate the capabilities of Active Cruise Control with Stop & Go feature,2 which can bring your
BMW to a complete stop if needed, its massive anti-lock brakes gripping with assurance. At lower speeds, readily
available torque provides quick acceleration, while the Active Steering option enhances the 6 Series’ nimble handling,
making quick lane changes and navigating tight streets a breeze. Surrounded by pedestrians, bicyclists and other
distractions? Head-up Display lets you keep your eyes on the road while giving you important driving information.
In the obstacle course that is urban driving, the 6 Series still proves it’s a winner.
1 650i Coupe with manual transmission; 5.4 seconds with Sport Automatic. 650i Convertible: 5.6 seconds with manual transmission;
5.7 seconds with Sport Automatic. BMW test results. BMW urges you to obey all posted speed laws and always wear safety belts.
2 A ctive Cruise Control is not a substitute for the driver’s own responsibility in adjusting speed and otherwise controlling the vehicle.
After evaluating road, traffic and visibility conditions, the driver must decide whether and how the system is used.
For details on the availability of standard and optional features, please refer to the Standard equipment | Optional equipment charts at the back of this brochure.

--- page 14 ---
Interior 26 | 27
The 650i’s alluring exterior is complemented by an elegant, well-appointed
interior. Seating for four is lavished in supple Dakota Leather or Pearl Leather,
which, in the Convertible, includes BMW’s unique Sun-Reflective Tech-
nology. This process incorporates mirror-like pigments into the leather
dye to reflect the sun’s infrared rays, helping to keep seats and other
u pholstered surfaces cooler to the touch, even when the top is left down.
The interior is enriched with a choice of three trims: genuine Maple or
Dark Birch Wood, or Brushed Aluminum; control knobs are appealingly
accented in Chrome Pearl Gray. Fill the cabin with 360 degrees of digitally
adjusted surround sound with the Premium Sound Package that includes
the Logic7 audio system, a six-disc CD player, and iPod® and USB adapter.
Then add HD Radio™ to receive free, digital broadcasts with CD-quality
sound, “multicast” FM stations, and innovative data services.
For details on the availability of standard and optional features, please refer to the
Standard equipment | Optional equipment charts at the back of this brochure.

Although its beauty invites inspection of every detail, the 6 Series cockpit is
designed so your eyes remain on the road and your hands on the wheel. All
primary d riving controls are ergonomically placed, and gauges can be read at
a glance, while the Head-up Display feature puts critical driving information
directly in your line of vision. To fully enjoy every moment while traveling,
you can access the most frequently used secondary f unctions – audio, cruise
control and (accessory) phone – via the multi-function steering wheel, the
iDrive Controller, or the six programmable buttons above the center console.
And if your 650i is upholstered in Pearl Leather, your passengers will feast
their eyes on the rich Black Nappa Leather that adds a distinctive touch to
the dashboard and center console.
For details on the availability of standard and optional features, please refer to the
Standard equipment | Optional equipment charts at the back of this brochure.
